name: Wave Runner
author: Vocal Monitor
description: Native (Skia) port of the Waveform Builder rendering engine. Consumes the same log-spaced FFT bins as the WebView TopVis (via streams["topVisBins"]) and parses the active wave config the host pushes through setConfig(json) — so output matches the JS engine bar-for-bar, just rendered through Skia. Bars + line + particles layers, every colour mode, asymmetric attack/release smoothing, contrast/tilt, response curves, mirror/elastic/spline/fill, particle physics (gravity/wind/drag/turbulence/burst). JSON parser is inline (no org.json dep), keeps the plugin portable to the PC DAW host.
